name: The Who

whyMatters.en: London four-piece that fused power-chord pop, live destruction lore, and Townshend concept albums (Tommy, Who’s Next) into hard-rock theatre.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组：把强力和弦流行、现场破坏传说与 Townshend 概念专集（Tommy、Who’s Next）融进 hard-rock 剧场。

note.en: Sequencer intro into arena power chords.
note.zh: 音序引入接入体育场强力和弦。

interviewQuotes.text: Rock is art and the stuff of life.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Pete Townshend

lyricQuotes: I hope I die before I get old

shortBio.en: Townshend / Daltrey / Entwistle / Moon; Baba O’Riley and My Generation are poles.
shortBio.zh: Townshend / Daltrey / Entwistle / Moon；Baba O’Riley 与 My Generation 是两极。

body.en:
Formed 1964. Mid-60s singles (My Generation) establish stutter vocal and feedback; Tommy invents rock-opera scale; Who’s Next (synthesizer/sequencer experiments) yields Baba O’Riley and Won’t Get Fooled Again.

Moon’s drums and Entwistle’s lead-bass are instrumental signatures. Live volume is part of the historical record.
body.zh:
1964 年组建。60 年代中期单曲（My Generation）确立口吃人声与反馈；Tommy 发明摇滚歌剧尺度；Who’s Next（合成器/音序实验）交出 Baba O’Riley 与 Won’t Get Fooled Again。

Moon 的鼓与 Entwistle 的主奏式贝斯是乐器签名。现场音量属历史记录的一部分。

title.zh: 强力和弦 + 概念野心

body.en:
The Who matter as the band that kept singles craft while inventing album-length narrative and synth-rock experiments for arenas.

Violence onstage is lore; arrangement is the durable export.
body.zh:
The Who 要紧处是：保持单曲工艺的同时，为体育场发明专辑时长叙事与合成器摇滚实验。

舞台暴力是传说；编曲才是耐久输出。

body.en:
Feedback, Entwistle solo break, Daltrey’s stutter—mod-era youth single that still reads as hard-rock proto.

Tempo and attitude first.
body.zh:
反馈、Entwistle 独奏段、Daltrey 口吃——仍可读作 hard-rock 原型的 mod 时代青年单曲。

速度与态度优先。

title.en: Baba O’Riley: sequencer into power chord
title.zh: Baba O’Riley：音序接入强力和弦

body.en:
ARP/Lowrey figure into full-band crash; violin solo; Daltrey vocal—Who’s Next teaching track.

Electronics without abandoning guitar war.
body.zh:
ARP/Lowrey 音型接入全乐队撞击；小提琴独奏；Daltrey 人声——Who’s Next 教材曲。

不放弃吉他战争的电子。

body.en:
Later hard rock cites the live assault; prog and concept acts cite Tommy/Quadrophenia permission.

DNA splits into volume culture and writer culture.
body.zh:
后来 hard rock 引用现场突击；prog 与概念乐队引用 Tommy/Quadrophenia 许可。

DNA 裂为音量文化与写作者文化。

body.en:
Interview lines about songwriting systems sit beside smashed-instrument stories.

Hold both as documented practices.
body.zh:
关于歌曲写作系统的访谈句，旁靠砸乐器故事。

二者都当作有文献的实践。

note.en: Stutter, smash, and volume as youth politics.
note.zh: 口吃、砸琴与音量即青年政治。

note.en: Power-chord violence + rock-opera ambition in one band DNA.
note.zh: 强力和弦暴力与摇滚歌剧野心同体。
